name: carousel
title: Carousel
description: A few peers looked at one or a few at a time in a box narrower than all of them: a gallery of pictures, onboarding cards, a shelf of cards on a narrow screen. Slides scroll natively with scroll snap (touch, trackpad, wheel) and the next one peeks at the edge; Previous and Next are the graphite tool keys with the chevron, off at the ends; the readout says where you are ("3 / 8", or the range in view) on the drum, and a polite status says it once the scroll settles. Never rotates on its own.
base: section, aria-roledescription="carousel"; slides are groups, roledescription "slide" (WAI-ARIA APG carousel, basic); CSS Scroll Snap and IntersectionObserver (Base UI has no carousel)
